path = "internal/web/assets/htmx.min.js"
precedence = "override"
SPDX-FileCopyrightText = "Big Sky Software"
SPDX-License-Identifier = "0BSD"

#              keymap 1.2.3, inputrules 1.5.1, schema-list 1.5.1, tables 1.8.5,

#              orderedmap, rope-sequence and w3c-keyname

#   licence  : MIT, except entities, which is BSD-2-Clause

path = "internal/web/assets/prosemirror.min.js"

SPDX-FileCopyrightText = ["Marijn Haverbeke and others", "Vitaly Puzrin and Alex Kocharin", "Mathias Bynens", "Felix Boehm"]
SPDX-License-Identifier = "MIT AND BSD-2-Clause"

precedence = "aggregate"

SPDX-License-Identifier = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
